# Bug report

## What is wrong?

Describe the problem clearly.

## Where is it?

Provide the file path, page, section, or URL.

## Type of problem

Mark any that apply:

- [ ] factual error
- [ ] broken link
- [ ] formatting/rendering issue
- [ ] contradictory guidance
- [ ] outdated guidance
- [ ] website issue
- [ ] repo structure issue
- [ ] other

## Suggested fix

If you know how it should be corrected, describe it here.

## Additional context

Add any supporting detail here.
